status: draft: not yet run against a real client
rule: Every step presses ONE input once and checks ONE result. No holds, repeats, sequences or timers: the same 1 input = 1 action rule the layout itself keeps.

steps.do: Run install.sh from the branch checkout as a normal user (no admin).
steps.expect: Prints Installed (or Updated) and exits 0.

steps.do: Run install.sh a second time.
steps.expect: Prints Already up to date; config/main.properties unchanged.

steps.do: Read client.controls.controller_input_maps_gdx_2 from config/main.properties.
steps.expect: Holds an entry for the virtual pad's name and for every managed name.

phases.name: Client starts and reaches the game world

steps.do: Start the client.
steps.expect: The launcher window appears and the client process is running.

steps.do: Log in with the test account (credentials come from the rig's broker, never from this repo).
steps.expect: Character select appears.

steps.do: Choose the character.
steps.expect: The game world is drawn: map, character sprite and hotbar are visible.

steps.do: Check the log for the virtual pad.
steps.expect: Log line 'Controller <name> ... attached' for the virtual pad.

phases.name: Each bound button does its one action
phases.pad_position: Xbox names; positions are SDL3 button numbers from tools/apply_native.LAYOUT

steps.expect: The character takes one step up.
The character takes one step down.
The character takes one step left.
The character takes one step right.
Confirm: talks to an adjacent NPC or confirms the open prompt.
Cancel: closes the dialog opened in C05.
The game's X action fires once (no menu left open afterwards).
The game's Y action fires once (no menu left open afterwards).
The Bag opens.
The Game Menu opens.
The Team window opens.
The client takes one screenshot; a new file appears in its screenshot folder.
Hotbar slot 1 highlights or its item is used once.
Hotbar slot 2 highlights or its item is used once.
Hotbar slot 3 highlights or its item is used once.
Hotbar slot 4 highlights or its item is used once.
Hotbar slot 5 highlights or its item is used once.
The hotbar shows the next page, once.
The hotbar returns to the previous page, once.
The Focus Ring highlight appears on screen.

phases.name: Focus Ring reaches every hotbar item

steps.do: Press View once, then move the ring with one press per move.
steps.expect: The ring lands on hotbar slot 1.

steps.do: Move to each of the 9 slots, one press per move.
steps.expect: The ring has stood on every one of the 9 slots; the tally lists all 9.

steps.do: Press B once.
steps.expect: The ring closes and the world is in control again.

steps.do: Open the Bag (RB), move through the pockets one press at a time, close with B.
steps.expect: Each press moves one pocket; B closes the Bag.

steps.do: Open the Game Menu (Menu), move to Party with one press per move, confirm with A, close with B.
steps.expect: The Party window opens and closes.

steps.do: Battle navigation, only if a wild battle starts by itself in the safe spot: move over the four battle options one press at a time, then run.
steps.expect: The cursor moves one option per press; Run leaves the battle. No battle is sought out.

steps.do: Open the remap screen from the branch (setup.py --ui). In it, swap two actions the screen allows (for example Bag and Team).
steps.expect: The screen shows no shared input and offers Apply.

steps.do: Apply, restart the client, log in again.
steps.expect: The game world is reached again.

steps.do: Press the input that now opens the Team window (it used to open the Bag).
steps.expect: The Team window opens; the other input opens the Bag.

steps.do: Restore the default layout in the screen and apply.
steps.expect: main.properties is byte for byte the A3 state; the old input opens the Bag again.

steps.do: Check the client process and take one more screenshot.
steps.expect: The client is still running and the picture changes when the character moves (not frozen).

steps.do: Log out through the Game Menu.
steps.expect: Back at the login or character select screen.

steps.do: Stop the client.
steps.expect: The process ends; no crash report is written.

steps.do: Uninstall with install.sh --uninstall.
steps.expect: Original main.properties restored byte for byte.

not_covered_here: The Steam wheel (needs Steam; hotbar slots 6-9, Pokedex, Friends, Screenshot-F12 via the wheel). The Linux CI proves the layout files only.
Windows and macOS: covered by the CI matrix, not by this run.
PlayStation and Switch Pro pads, ARM, Steam Deck Game Mode: unverified until a person tests them.
